facts: The NIOSH archived table entry for potassium hydroxide (CAS 1310-58-3) specifies the recommendation applies to solution <70% only (Prevent skin contact).
For potassium hydroxide (solution <70%), the table places these barriers in the 8-hour group: Butyl, Natural, Nitrile, PVC, Viton.
For potassium hydroxide (solution <70%), the table places these barriers in the 4-hour group: Teflon, PE/EVAL.
